title: Scroll video and autoplay policy
promptLanguage: Scrub a silent image sequence or a muted clip with the scroll, and keep a poster as the first paint. Sound never starts by itself.
notes: Chrome's autoplay note is why decorative video stays muted. The sequence itself is generated for the brand, not taken from a reference site.
reducedMotion: Reduced motion shows the poster and does not scrub the sequence.
